v2Rule: only MONEY/PERCENT/RATIO, and only in the region literally named 'operative'
v3Rule: every kind the scanner recognises, in every region of the unit
anchorRule: a value is accounted only when a CRITICAL/MATERIAL item span contains it; an INFORMATIONAL or REVIEW_UNCERTAIN item accounts for nothing
noiseInteraction: a value inside deterministically non-semantic source (page furniture, a heading) is not reported; conversely a fragment carrying a value is NEVER dismissed as noise, so the suppression cannot swallow one
blocking: any unaccounted value refuses semanticallyComplete on its own, with no unaccounted text required
knownLimitation: the scanner's own recall bounds this rule: an amount written only in words ('five million dollars') is not a scanned value, so it is covered by TEXT accounting rather than value accounting. Text accounting has no vocabulary or length gate, so such a clause is still surfaced when unanchored - but it will not appear in uninventoriedValues.
